summary: Verified Saola Claude Sonnet 4.5 chat + Ecosystem Poker post-lobby polish (YOUR TURN banner + animated tile reveal with result chips & colored halo). All target functionality works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Poker.jsx is ~382 lines — still manageable but approaching split threshold; consider splitting RESULT_META + Lobby into separate files if it grows further.
server.py contains both API routing and PokerRoom game-logic class (~590 lines). Recommend extracting poker logic into /app/backend/poker.py to keep server.py focused.
Saola chat /api/saola/chat returns raw text/plain stream rather than SSE; works but no chunk delimiters — fine for current usage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_saola_chat.py covers Saola streaming (asserts no fallback markers), root, poker/create. Frontend Saola: open data-testid='saola-toggle', use saola-input/saola-send, poll for streamed response inside saola-chat-panel (~3-8s typical). Poker dual-context test: host fills name on lobby (input[0]), clicks host-room, gets data-testid='room-code-display'. Guest navigates to /poker/{CODE} — note guest side did NOT show a name input (auto-joined as 'Scholar'); this might be intentional auto-join via URL. Active player gets data-testid='your-turn-banner', clicks hand-tile-*, fills claim-input, clicks slide-btn, then other clicks challenge-btn — board-tile-0 then shows colored box-shadow halo + result chip (TRUTHFUL/EXPOSED LIE/PASSED · TRUE/PASSED · LIE/PARASITE DRAIN/ORACLE SIGHT) in Bebas Neue uppercase. Verified halo style example: box-shadow: rgba(255, 64, 64, 0.6) 0px 0px 22px (red halo for EXPOSED LIE).
